N1.obligation: The executed test depth matches the risk the change actually carries
N1.detail: The Stage 4 table's last row governs (presentation-confined, no state effect), warranting criterion-level checks only. Independent corroboration was obtained rather than assumed: the document is absent from the installer payload map (267 files) and no script under runtime/ and no module under tests/ reads it. Depth was deliberately set above that floor - all five verification scripts, the full root unittest suite, and two named test modules were executed at baseline - because constraint C-007 makes verification-script verdict parity the declared regression measure and pinning that baseline is this phase's purpose.

N2.obligation: No criterion was recorded as met on evidence that does not demonstrate it
N2.detail: Exactly one criterion reads met: AC-001, the design's assumption A-004 that the sixteen-directory count remains current. Its evidence is a direct filesystem enumeration executed in this run, differenced against the row keys parsed from the section, yielding sixteen directories, twelve documented, and an undocumented set identical to the design's asserted gap. A sceptical reader given only that enumeration reaches the same result. The other nine criteria state post-change conditions with no change in existence and are recorded blocked rather than inferred to hold; in particular AC-005 (sixteen of sixteen) was not scored not-met, because the pre-change count of twelve is the condition the change exists to correct, not a failure of it.

N3.obligation: Every regression the change could plausibly cause was looked for
N3.detail: The regression surface was fixed before examination and every element was exercised at baseline. One plausible regression was actively investigated and ruled out rather than assumed: had the orientation document been part of the installer payload, an edit without a bundle re-sync would fail the payload parity check, so the payload map was enumerated and the document confirmed absent. A second was found rather than assumed away: the parity baseline for the self-hosting script moved across three executions in this run with no edit in between, recorded as DF-001. Residual gaps are named in Untested areas rather than left silent.
